home.heroSubtitle: A modern unified sign-in platform built on Nuxt 3, supporting multiple sign-in and sign-up methods. Secure, convenient and extensible.

about.title: About Caomei Auth Unified Sign-In Platform
about.intro: Caomei Auth is a modern unified sign-in platform built on the Nuxt full-stack framework. It supports OAuth 2.0 and integrates email, username, phone number, verification code and social sign-in methods. Secure, convenient and extensible.

features.oauth: OAuth 2.0 support for easy integration with any application
features.methods: Multiple sign-in and sign-up methods: email, username, phone number, codes and social accounts
features.permissions: User permission management powered by better-auth
features.responsive: Responsive design with a friendly user experience
features.deploy: Deployable on Node.js, Docker, Vercel, Cloudflare Workers and more

stack.framework: Full-stack framework: Nuxt 3.x (Vue 3.x + SSR + API routes)
stack.auth: Auth and permissions: better-auth, OAuth 2.0 server
stack.notification: Email and SMS: nodemailer, third-party SMS providers

about.themeText: The primary color is red (#e63946), conveying security and energy. The full primary palette is used for a modern, crisp look, and all styles are driven by SCSS variables so themes stay consistent and switchable.
about.license: This project is released under the {license}. Contributions and discussions are welcome.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

collect.label: Data collection
collect.intro: We collect the following types of personal information:
collect.emailText: Used for account registration, sign-in verification, password reset, security notices, and (with your explicit consent) service information and product updates.
collect.phoneText: Used for SMS verification, multi-factor authentication and account protection, and (with your explicit consent) security codes and important service notices.
collect.usernameText: Used for account identification, profile display and personalization.
collect.credentialText: Including hashed passwords and session tokens, used for authentication and account security.
collect.deviceText: Including IP address, browser type and operating system version, used for security monitoring and service improvements.

use.label: Data usage
use.intro: The personal data we collect is used for the following purposes:
use.item1: Providing account registration, sign-in and authentication
use.item2: Protecting account security, including abnormal sign-in monitoring and multi-factor authentication
use.item3: Sending important security notices and service updates
use.item4: Improving the user experience and service features
use.item5: Complying with legal requirements and preventing security risks
use.item6: Sending product updates and feature announcements with your explicit consent

storage.label: Data storage
storage.intro: User data is stored on secure servers, with the following safeguards:
storage.item1: Sensitive data (such as passwords) is stored encrypted
storage.item2: Access is restricted to authorized personnel on a need-to-know basis
storage.item3: Data is backed up regularly and audited for security
storage.item4: Retention: active accounts are retained indefinitely; inactive accounts may be deleted when the last sign-in is more than one year old

marketing.label: Marketing communications:
marketing.item1: We may use your email address or phone number for important service notices (such as security alerts and service updates)
marketing.item2: Marketing messages (such as promotions and feature announcements) are only sent with your explicit consent
marketing.item3: You can unsubscribe at any time through the link in the email or by contacting us
marketing.item4: Even after unsubscribing from marketing, you will still receive important service and security notices

rights.label: Your rights
rights.intro: You have the following data rights:
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact our support team at {email}
rights.accessText: request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
rights.rectifyText: request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data
rights.eraseText: request deletion of your personal data (subject to legal requirements)
rights.restrictText: request that we restrict processing of your personal data
rights.portabilityText: receive your data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format
rights.objectText: object to processing based on our legitimate interests

privacy.sentry: Error monitoring: we use {sentry} to monitor system errors and performance issues so the service stays stable. It collects only technical error data and no sensitive personal information.

clarity.label: Behavior analytics
clarity.text: We use {clarity} to analyze how users interact with key pages so we can improve the experience. The tool hashes user identifiers automatically to protect privacy. We only collect necessary interaction data on key pages such as sign-in, sign-up and security settings, and never record passwords, email addresses or other sensitive input.

baidu.label: Traffic statistics
baidu.text: We use {baidu} to collect site traffic data such as page views, referral sources and visit duration, so we can understand usage and improve the service. It collects anonymous statistics and no personally identifying information. You can block the analytics script through browser settings or extensions.
baidu.name: Baidu Analytics

google.label: Site analytics
google.text: We use {google} to analyze traffic and user behavior so we can understand how the service is used and improve it. Google Analytics collects anonymous usage data including page views, interactions, device information and approximate location. The data is anonymized and does not directly identify you, and Google processes it under its own privacy policy. You can opt out by installing the Google Analytics opt-out add-on or adjusting your browser settings.

thirdParty.label: Third-party sign-in
thirdParty.text: We may integrate the following third-party sign-in services; when a service is enabled, it processes your data under its own privacy policy:

privacy.shareText: we do not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties without your explicit consent. Data may be shared when required by law or by government authorities, to protect users or the public, or with third-party services you have explicitly authorized.
privacy.cookieText: we use cookies to keep you signed in and to personalize the service. You can manage cookies in your browser settings, though some features may stop working.

terms.title: Terms of Service

conduct.label: Code of conduct
conduct.intro: When using this platform you must follow these rules:
conduct.item1: Comply with applicable laws and the platform's usage rules
conduct.item2: Do not use the platform for illegal activities, including but not limited to fraud, money laundering or spreading illegal content
conduct.item3: Do not attack the system, attempt unauthorized access or interfere with normal operation
conduct.item4: Do not register with false information or impersonate others
conduct.item5: Protect your account and never share sign-in credentials

privacy.label: Personal information:
privacy.item1: You agree that we collect, use and protect your personal information in accordance with the Privacy Policy
privacy.item2: You may view, modify or delete your personal information at any time
privacy.item3: You may choose whether to receive marketing communications
privacy.item4: We will not use your personal information for unauthorized commercial purposes

marketing.label: Marketing consent:
marketing.item1: At sign-up you can choose whether to receive product updates and promotions
marketing.item2: We may send important service notices by email or SMS; these are necessary for account security and normal use of the service
marketing.item3: You can unsubscribe from marketing messages at any time without affecting your use of the service

disclaimer.label: Disclaimer:
disclaimer.item1: We work to provide a stable and secure service but cannot guarantee uninterrupted, error-free or vulnerability-free operation
disclaimer.item2: We are not liable for interruptions caused by force majeure (such as natural disasters, network failures or government actions)
disclaimer.item3: You are responsible for your own actions; we are not liable for losses resulting from your violation of these terms or applicable law
disclaimer.item4: We are not directly responsible for the availability or security of third-party services such as third-party sign-in

dispute.label: Dispute resolution:
dispute.item1: Both parties should first attempt to resolve disputes through friendly negotiation
dispute.item2: If negotiation fails, either party may bring a lawsuit in the court where the platform is located

terms.ipText: all content on the platform (including but not limited to software, interface design, documentation and trademarks) is protected by intellectual property law. Without explicit authorization you may not copy, modify, distribute, sell or otherwise use this content.
terms.monitoringText: to keep the service reliable and secure we monitor system status and key user operations. Collected data is used only for technical optimization, troubleshooting and security protection, strictly in line with the Privacy Policy.
terms.changesText: we may adjust service features based on business needs, legal requirements or technical developments. For material changes (such as policy updates affecting user rights) we will notify users in advance by email or in-app notice.
